1.20.1.3.3.2: Fixes the contextual Iron's mana bar staying visible at full displayed mana when the maximum is fractional. Preserves held casting items, Always/Never settings, and XP-bar restoration. Matching fix on Forge 1.20.1 and NeoForge 1.21.1. No config, network protocol, or save-format changes from 3.3.1.
1.20.1.3.2.4: Server performance release. The Mana Well ritual no longer scans every entity section in range on every tick while lit; per-tick handlers stop querying Forge's ModList each player tick; the shared-pool mana ceiling no longer rewrites Iron's MAX_MANA modifier (and broadcasts an attribute packet) every regen interval when nothing changed; resonance is synced to the client only when it changes. No gameplay, config, packet or save-format changes.
1.20.1.3.2.3: Fixes Ars 'n' Spells rituals doing nothing at all. Placing a Spellbook Binding, Spell Transcription, Spell Uninscription or Mana Infusion tablet on a ritual brazier and lighting it consumed nothing, produced nothing and reported nothing - the brazier just stayed lit. These rituals never told Ars they had finished, so their payload never ran; they have been inert since 3.0.0. They now burn for about three seconds and complete. Ritual messages also reach the player who lit the brazier instead of being dropped if they walked away, /ans bind_scroll_to_irons_book now honours allow_ars_spells_in_irons_spellbooks, and the binding instructions have been corrected in game and in the docs.
1.20.1.3.2.2: Fixes fake "Ars 'n' Spells" spell scrolls turning up in Iron's Spellbooks loot - exploration chests, Mystery Scroll Pouches, magic-mob drops and wandering traders. These were the mod's internal ars_cross_* proxy spells, which do nothing outside a spellbook that carries the matching Ars spell. Ars 'n' Spells does not modify any loot table; the proxies simply never opted out of Iron's random-spell pool, and now do. A stray scroll already in your world becomes a blank Iron's scroll the first time you right-click it, and the eight missing spell-description translations have been added.
1.20.1.3.2.1: Fixes a mixin conflict that stopped the game from loading at all when One Mana Bar was installed, taking twelve mods down with it. Failures in the optional Iron's and Covenant integrations now degrade to a warning instead of aborting startup for the whole pack. Iron's scrolls have been casting completely free in every previous build - scroll cost enforcement now actually applies, so scrolls cost whatever scroll_cost_mode says (default: the same as casting normally).
1.20.1.3.2.0: Fixes one Ars spell draining the entire mana pool on hybrid mode, ritual tablets rendering as the missing-texture checkerboard, and a client crash when hovering a Spell Loom scroll. Adds the Mana Infusion and Mana Well ritual tablets, which had no item and could never be placed on a brazier.
1.20.1.3.1.0: Fixes the Iron's Inscription Table crash on exported scrolls (client AND server), orphan wheel entries left by unbinding, free Ars casts when the Virtue Ring system is disabled, and ars_cross_* ghosts in JEI/EMI. Spell schools now come from Ars Nouveau's own metadata, and removing an addon fails loudly instead of silently changing a bound spell.
1.20.1.3.0.3: Cross-cast fixes: a bound Ars spell equipped in the Curios spellbook slot now casts (it silently did nothing), binding rolls back instead of half-succeeding, Iron's affinity/cooldown/LP/progression no longer double-bill proxy casts, and unreadable payloads are refused before anything is consumed.
1.20.1.3.0.2: Affinity decay curve fix (~20x too fast), datapack tags for rings/blasphemies/source jars, Spell Loom advancement chain and screen readability, aura_failure_mode, config-driven progression curve.
1.20.1.3.0.1: Audit remediation: fixed uncraftable ritual tablets with Iron's loaded (item tag), config screen readability, Iron's-less boot crash fix, LP toggle gating.
1.20.1.3.0.0: Cross-cast inscription: export Ars spells onto Iron's scrolls and bind them into Iron's spellbooks via the Spell Loom.
